mechanism_narrative: A week-on-week collapse in WORKPLACES exceeding 20 points paired with RESIDENTIAL above +14 identifies a work-from-home shock that strips commuter and office-corridor footfall from discretionary venues, so RETAIL_REC declines over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES falls more than 20 points week-on-week while RESIDENTIAL rises above +14
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES moved from -16.3 at t-1w to -44.3 at t-0w while RESIDENTIAL moved from 9.4 to 14.3
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC's next-28-day mean is at or above its last-28-day mean in more than half of the instances where WORKPLACES dropped more than 20 points week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM holding above +25 for two consecutive weeks marks precautionary stockpiling under anticipated tightening; households divert discretionary budgets into provisions, so RETAIL_REC falls over the following week.
